scope: The bundled corpus shipped by GitHub Pages is counted separately from user imports saved only in each browser profile.

sources.title: ব্যবহারকারী-প্রদত্ত সিরাজী দলিল সংকলন
sources.original_source: User-provided الدليل.odt, as identified in the user's public al-muafy-faraid repository JSON.
sources.extraction_method: Structured JSON fields converted into searchable passages; no book text was downloaded from Shamela.
sources.access_or_rights_notes: User authorized this app project and the source JSON is already public in the user's repository. Rights to the underlying quoted works are not independently verified.
sources.known_gaps: Printed book title, edition, author attribution, volume, and page mapping are not established by this JSON. sourceRow is an ODT row label and is not presented as a book page. Not a complete Sirajiyyah book or a full Shamela corpus.

sources.title: السراجية في الميراث
sources.author_attribution: سراج الدين محمد بن عبد الرشيد السجاوندي الحنفي (as stated on the online book title page)
sources.edition: The referenced online edition presents القمرية commentary and identifies Madina Library, Karachi. Publication year and pagination-to-print-edition mapping were not verified.
sources.retrieval_method: Bibliographic page and its table of contents inspected. No book text was downloaded or copied into the local corpus.
sources.known_gaps: Local search cannot search the 112 pages visible on the remote site; edition year, print page mapping, and reproduction permission remain unknown.
